scientific_integrity: Analytic tagged-pair survival argument; 62 exact-rational finite regression checks supplement but do not replace proof; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: First-order uniform asymptotic for even order and triangle-free fixed-maximum-degree forbidden graphs only; does not cover growing exclusion degrees, weighted arrivals, or a second-order expansion. General graph RSA results are credited. Older full-text priority comparisons remain incomplete.
title: A universal rare-jamming coefficient for dense dimer adsorption with bounded-degree exclusions
